{{Quote|There is a local gang of teens called the Laser Flits. They are a relatively new gang operating here out of Mos Espa. I have the location of their hideout.|[[W. Wald|Wald]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:WW" />}}
The '''Laser Flit Hangout''' was an underground building on the outskirts of [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. It was used as an hideout by the [[Laser Flits]], a local gang of teens.<ref name="SWG:WW" />

==History==
When the Laser Flits ambushed a delivery of [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] parts from [[Wald's Parts|Watto's shop]] destined for [[Qord D'Baelor]], [[W. Wald|Wald]] paid a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to retrieve the parts. The spacer entered the Laser Flit's hangout, killed many gang members and brought back the swoop parts.<ref name="SWG:WW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Laser Flit Hangout was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:WW" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> It was added to the game as part of the quest titled "[[W:c:swg:Wald's Woes|Wald's Woes]]" with the release of "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 2|Chapter 2: The Talus Incident]]," on [[August 1]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Chapter 2: The Talus Incident Publish Notes, August 1st">{{SonyForumsCite|full_url=http://soe.lithium.com/swg/board/message?board.id=DevDiscussion&message.id=58871|text="Chapter 2: The Talus Incident" Publish Notes, August 1st}}</ref>
